Building an open education system on-chain

TinyTap’s mission is to reduce dependency on traditional education by creating a decentralized system owned and operated by the community.

By tokenizing the learning process, Educators can own their content and unlock new earning opportunities, Supporters can transparently endorse projects they believe in, while Students get equal educational opportunities worldwide.
